name: Sword of the Free Will: Eternal Starfire

pages.title: Sword of the Free Will: Eternal Starfire
pages.text: §lWeapon Effects: §r$(br)Armor +100, Armor Toughness +25, 25% damage reduction, with built-in Sharpness XII, Smite XII, Looting XII, Knockback II, and Dawn I.$(br2)§lPassive "Eternal Spark": §r$(br)Prevents one fatal hit, with a 300-second cooldown.$(br2)§lSkill "Starfire Mark": §r$(br)Attacks mark the target and release a blue flame sword wave; attacking the same target again while your mark remains increases the damage by 100%.

pages.title: Anvil Left Slot: Sword of the Free Will
pages.text: Place the Sword of the Free Will in the left anvil slot.

pages.title: Anvil Right Slot: Dawn Star
pages.text: Place 1 Dawn Star in the right anvil slot. The upgrade costs 5 experience levels.

pages.title: Anvil Output: Eternal Starfire
pages.text: With the Sword of the Free Will on the left and the Dawn Star on the right, the anvil outputs the Eternal Starfire variant. §c§lImportant: all accumulated Dawn levels on the sword are cleared after the upgrade!§r
